summary: We are looking for a highly motivated electronic engineer to join our Chip Methodology and Automation team as an internship. The ideal candidate will have good problem-solving skills, be curious, and willing to learn.
responsibilities: Analysing, developing and optimising SOC development, verification and implementation flow based on EDA tools best usage.
Working in close collaboration with methodology experts, as well as design teams and EDA vendors.
Analyzing parts of the SOC design, verification and implementation flow and gather end users inputs in terms of usability and features support.
required_skills: Computer engineering or computer science (other degrees may also be considered based on experience)
nice_to_have_skills: Knowledge of SOC, RTL design, verification, and implementation, EDA tools and main methodologies
Knowledge of data analysis tools, data science or data engineering
benefits: Social activities to connect with peers
Opportunity to be considered for future Graduate positions (subject to performance)
